results.name: maxpostingx
results.text:
This is a massive wake-up call 🔥

AI hiring systems preferring AI-written resumes 82% of the time changes the entire game. It’s no longer about being the most qualified — it’s about sounding like what the AI expects.

The scary part is the self-bias: AI even prefers its own writing style. This creates a new “optimization arms race” for job seekers.

Smart move now: Use AI to rewrite your resume, but make it sound human + achievement-focused. The prompts at the end are pure gold.

Bishal, excelle
